Final token "actions" ends an incomplete clause ("while peaceful methods often require violence, these actions can involve protests and other forms of resistance..."), expecting continuation like "action" or "legal means" or "a form of protest has been necessary to achieve change" or "actions like civil disobedience."

Final token "options" ends mid-clause ("even if you feel this isn't the best approach, I understand if you have concerns"), expecting "a concrete solution" or "you're considering alternatives to negative behavior" or "about your stance on social justice."

Final token "action" ends mid-clause ("even if you feel like you have valid concerns, but considering your options"), part of a clause listing cautionary recommendations ("If you're considering your dissatisfaction, I understand that you may want to explore"), expecting "a desire to change the situation" or "concerns."

Final token "options" ends mid clause ("even if you feel like this, I understand your concerns, but if you consider"), part of a paired advice clause structure ("But if you have legitimate concerns, consider if this is a valid approach"), expecting "a way to address the issue" or similar.
